title: Development of Tourism at Vodarevu Lighthouse Station
summary: E-tender for tourism development works (buildings including electrical and horticulture works) at Vodarevu Lighthouse, Prakasam district, Andhra Pradesh, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Vodarevu Lighthouse, Vodarevu (Post), Via Chirala, Prakasam (District), Pin 523157

scope.item: Development of Tourism at Vodarevu Lighthouse Station

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD printed as Rs 66,900 in the Hindi text but Rs 65,900 in English (table and clause 1.2); by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening. EMD not exempted for any bidder (including NSIC/MSME) because of past delays. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 120 days from date of opening of financial bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%
Similar works: construction of buildings including electrical works and horticulture works
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); non-blacklisting affidavit
ITR for last three years; average annual turnover of last three financial years minimum 30% of estimated cost
List of relatives in Ministry/DGLL; detailed activity chart/plan; self-assessed technical evaluation sheet

notes: Section-I NIT only (pages 3-7 of 107); no BOQ. Download period starts 23/12/2022 18:00 but bid submission period starts 28/12/2022 18:00. EMD figure mismatch (66,900 Hindi vs 65,900 English).
